name: Evervault
title: evervault.com
shortDescription: Evervault offers a robust solution for businesses seeking secure and flexible payment processing capabilities. It allows companies to tokenize cards, comply with PCI standards, and avoid gateway lock-in, enhancing both security and operational efficiency. Ideal for entities like booking aggregators, Evervault enables compliant sharing of card data with third parties, optimizing payment costs and acceptance rates through selective routing.
pros: Highly flexible and compliant payment solutions
Developer-friendly with SDKs and REST API
Supports multiple payment processors and gateways
cons: May require technical expertise to integrate
Focused mainly on payment security, less on other areas
